# Stream

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Stream>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A time-ordered sequence of observations or samples produced by a sensor or platform over a time interval. The ordering of samples is implicit via their individual timestamps, not asserted as a list structure ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). A stream is the canonical source from which a continuous trajectory may be derived by the solver layer.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to group a time-ordered run of observations or samples about one entity from a sensor or platform — the canonical source a solver derives a continuous trajectory from (no list structure is asserted).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a single isolated reading (use a bare [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)) and avoid encoding sample order as an RDF list — ordering is implicit via each sample's timestamp ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), and the interpolated trajectory is a solver concern.

### How to use

- Mint the [`Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md), bind its subject with the functional [`gmeow:streamOf`](../properties/gmeow-streamOf.md), attach readings via [`gmeow:streamSample`](../properties/gmeow-streamSample.md), name [`gmeow:streamPlatform`](../properties/gmeow-streamPlatform.md) / [`gmeow:streamSensor`](../properties/gmeow-streamSensor.md), and bound it with the functional [`gmeow:streamInterval`](../properties/gmeow-streamInterval.md); an entity reaches its streams through [`gmeow:hasStream`](../properties/gmeow-hasStream.md).

### Examples

- ex:roverTrack a [`gmeow:Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md); [`gmeow:streamOf`](../properties/gmeow-streamOf.md) ex:rover; [`gmeow:streamSample`](../properties/gmeow-streamSample.md) ex:fix1.
